items.headline: Transamerica Expands AI Partnership with Amazon Web Services
items.summary: Transamerica has deepened its collaboration with Amazon Web Services to scale artificial intelligence across its enterprise operations.

items.headline: BlackRock, Inc. Files Disclosure of Voting Rights in ICG PLC
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. reported an acquisition or disposal of voting rights in ICG PLC, a UK-based issuer, with the threshold crossed on November 13, 2026.

items.summary: The International Brotherhood of Teamsters held a rally in Manhattan to protest the firing of approximately 200 delivery drivers following Amazon's cancellation of a contract with a delivery service p

items.headline: NVIDIA Reports Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
items.summary: NVIDIA announced its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2027, reporting revenue of $115.8 billion, a 103% increase year-over-year.

items.headline: Generation Life Launches ConfidencePlus Annuity with BlackRock Alliance
items.summary: Generation Life has introduced an investment-linked lifetime annuity product, ConfidencePlus, developed in partnership with BlackRock.

items.headline: Broadcom to Invest $1 Billion in Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Broadcom has agreed to invest $1 billion in Anthropic's initial public offering as part of a strategic commitment involving major technology suppliers.

items.headline: Microsoft Launches AI Transparency Initiative
items.summary: Microsoft has introduced an AI Transparency Initiative aimed at establishing common standards for security, governance, and transparency in artificial intelligence models.

items.headline: Rockwell Automation Launches GPU-Enabled Industrial Computing with NVIDIA
items.summary: Rockwell Automation has introduced new industrial computing solutions powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing to enhance edge AI capabilities.

items.headline: Amazon Expands Grocery Delivery to Include Prepared Meals
items.summary: Amazon has added ready-to-eat and heat-and-eat meal options to its same-day grocery delivery and Amazon Now services.

items.headline: BlackRock Designated as Critical Third Party for UK Financial Sector
items.summary: The UK government has designated BlackRock as a critical third party for the financial sector, subjecting the firm to increased regulatory oversight.

items.headline: Microsoft Commences Ignite 2026 Conference
items.summary: Microsoft has launched its annual Ignite conference in San Francisco, utilizing Haivision's video ecosystem to support global live event production.

items.headline: Mizuho Initiates BlackRock at Outperform With $1,450 Price Target
items.summary: Mizuho has initiated coverage of BlackRock, Inc. with an 'Outperform' rating and a price target of $1,450.

items.headline: NVIDIA Issues Warning to Chip Buyers Regarding US Export Compliance
items.summary: NVIDIA has cautioned customers about potential US legal risks associated with providing remote access to advanced chips for Chinese firms.

items.headline: Microsoft Expands Use of Haivision Live Video Ecosystem
items.summary: Microsoft has selected Haivision's video transport and control solutions to support the production of over 600 global events annually.

items.headline: BlackRock Participates in Bajaj Finance Private Share Offering
items.summary: BlackRock, alongside other institutional investors, participated in a $1.2 billion private share offering by Bajaj Finance.

items.headline: Generali Expects FY26 Adjusted EPS Growth Above Target
items.summary: Generali announced it is on track to surpass its 2027 strategic targets, with expectations for annual earnings per share (EPS) growth to exceed 14% for the 2024-2026 period.

items.headline: Enagás Wins Arbitration Ruling Against Peru Over TGP, COGA Investment
items.summary: Enagás has secured a favorable arbitration ruling in its dispute with the Peruvian government regarding its investments in Transportadora de Gas del Perú (TGP) and Compañía Operadora de Gas del Amazon

items.headline: Berenberg Updates Price Target and Estimates for Bayer
items.summary: Berenberg has updated its price target and financial estimates for Bayer, citing positive momentum within the company's pharmaceuticals division.

items.headline: SPIE Signs Agreement to Acquire ENPROM Group
items.summary: SPIE has announced the signing of an agreement to acquire 100% of the ENPROM Group to expand its high-voltage power engineering and installation capabilities.

items.headline: Equinor Announces Share Allocation to Primary Insiders
items.summary: Equinor ASA has announced the allocation of shares to certain primary insiders and their close associates under the company's share saving plan.

items.headline: flatexDEGIRO Announces Governance Strengthening and Planned Merger of Bank and Holding Company
items.summary: flatexDEGIRO SE is moving to simplify its corporate structure by merging its bank subsidiary, flatexDEGIRO Bank SE, with the holding company, while simultaneously harmonizing its board leadership.

items.headline: Nordex Group Signs Framework Agreements with Vattenfall for Onshore Wind Projects
items.summary: The Nordex Group has entered into two three-year framework agreements with Vattenfall to support onshore wind projects in Germany and the United Kingdom.

items.headline: dm Expands Partnership with Vusion to Digitalize 2,000 Stores
items.summary: VusionGroup has announced a major expansion of its partnership with German retailer dm to digitalize approximately 2,000 stores.

items.headline: Zealand Pharma Initiates Phase 2 ZYNERGY Trial for Petrelintide and Enicepatide Combination
items.summary: Zealand Pharma has announced the start of its Phase 2 ZYNERGY clinical trial, evaluating the co-administration of petrelintide and enicepatide in individuals with obesity or overweight.

items.headline: Citi Research Lowers Target Price for DBS Group Holdings
items.summary: Citi Research has adjusted its target price for DBS Group Holdings Ltd, reducing it from S$80.30 to S$78.00.

items.headline: Barclays Upgrades United Internet AG to 'Overweight'
items.summary: Investment bank Barclays has raised its price target for United Internet AG from 30 to 34 euros and maintained an 'Overweight' rating.

items.headline: Takeda Receives US FDA Approval for Nelkarmi (neladalkib) in ALK-Positive NSCLC
items.summary: The US Food and Drug Administration has approved Takeda's Nelkarmi (neladalkib) for the treatment of patients with previously-treated advanced ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer.

items.headline: UBS Group AG Discloses Major Shareholder Notification Regarding Bang & Olufsen A/S
items.summary: Bang & Olufsen A/S announced that it received a major shareholder notification from UBS Group AG concerning its shareholding as of November 11, 2026.

items.headline: BASF Reportedly Preparing Renewed Takeover Bid for Evonik
items.summary: BASF is reportedly exploring a new, higher takeover offer for specialty chemicals rival Evonik Industries, potentially ranging between 26 and 28 euros per share.

items.headline: Norwegian Block Exchange Files for Bank License in Latvia
items.summary: Norwegian Block Exchange AS (NBX) has submitted an application for a banking license in Latvia to establish the NBX Digital Asset Bank.

items.headline: Cereno Scientific Chairman Resigns
items.summary: Cereno Scientific has announced the resignation of its Chairman of the Board.

items.headline: poLight ASA and Suzhou Linkhou Robot Co., Ltd. Collaborate on Robotic Vision Systems
items.summary: poLight ASA has entered into a collaboration with Suzhou Linkhou Robot Co., Ltd. to integrate its solid-state autofocus technology into next-generation robotic vision systems.

items.headline: Lytix Biopharma Raises 80 Million NOK in Financing
items.summary: Lytix Biopharma has successfully raised 80 million NOK through a combination of a private placement and a retail offering.

items.headline: MS Industrie AG Confirms 2026 Guidance Following Strong Nine-Month Results
items.summary: MS Industrie AG reported a 4.9% increase in revenue for the first nine months of 2026 and confirmed its full-year guidance, supported by strong performance in its MS XTEC division.

items.headline: Xbrane Biopharma Receives Swedish Regulatory Approval for Drug Import and EU Sale
items.summary: Xbrane Biopharma has secured regulatory authorization in Sweden to import drugs and facilitate their distribution within the European Union.

items.headline: Turbo Energy Announces Proposed Acquisition of IM2 and Greentech
items.summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. has announced a proposed all-share acquisition of IM2 and Greentech to expand its integrated energy technology platform.

items.headline: Sòphia High Tech Joins LANSSET Committee to Expand Aerospace and Defense Presence in Southeast Asia
items.summary: Sòphia High Tech, a strategic investment of Saentra Forge (Genenta Science S.p.A.), has joined the LANSSET committee of the Italian Chamber of Commerce in Singapore to bolster its aerospace and defens

items.headline: MakoLab Reports Quarterly Financial Results
items.summary: MakoLab S.A. reported its financial results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, showing a loss per share and a decline in revenue compared to the same period last year.

items.headline: Xer Technologies Introduces X12 Hybrid VTOL Drone
items.summary: Xer Technologies has unveiled the X12, a new hybrid vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) drone designed for maritime surveillance and long-endurance operations.

items.headline: Adler Group S.A. Announces Preliminary Publication Schedule for Quarterly Reports
items.summary: Adler Group S.A. has issued a preliminary announcement regarding the upcoming publication of its quarterly reports and interim statements.
